description: Connect Haltestellen Niedersachsen & Bremen - INSPIRE View Service (WMS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps2.connect-info.net. WMS or INSPIRE-View-Service, which contains combined stops (including names) in Lower Saxony and Bremen. The bus, metro, tram and train stops are shown. With the URL, your OGC-compliant GIS client should open up the possibility of targeted access. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Connect Stations Lower Saxony & Bremen - INSPIRE View Service (WMS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Haltestellen, humanInteractionService, ÖPNV, Haltestellennamen, inspireidentifiziert, Haltestellenpunkte. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
